title: Generated SPATIAL_INDEX body recovery profile
scope: CLI disposition for bounded malformed SPATIAL_INDEX OBJECTS bodies at revisions with a parser-failing body mutation, including continuation, strict refusal, and explicit-partial output readback.

selection.source: P6-F typed OBJECTS parser and writer inventory
selection.reason: DRW_SpatialIndex has typed DWG parse and write routes. Its generated body contains the two timestamp fields consumed before the version-bounded opaque tail, allowing a bounded negative profile without changing parser behavior.

source.provenance: Generated from scratch by the local dwg_local_roundtrip test writer and removed by the test runner.
source.profile: One SPATIAL_INDEX at handle 0x700 owned by modelspace, with timestamps 300 and 400, followed by a LINE at handle 0x701.
source.mutation: The generator searches the bounded object frame for a one-bit mutation rejected by DRW_SpatialIndex::parseDwg while preserving the object handle and common prologue.

assertions: Each admitted generated source records one failed OBJECTS frame, continues to the following LINE, and balances source/published/failed frame accounting.
Strict ASCII/Binary conversion refuses atomically and preserves the destination sentinel at AC1015, AC1018, and AC1021 source revisions.
Explicit-partial ASCII/Binary conversion and fresh DXF readback retain the LINE for each admitted source revision.
No recovery or support claim is made for AC1024, AC1027, or AC1032 because the bounded generator found no parser-failing mutation there.

validation.syntax: python3 -m py_compile tests/dwg2dxf_cli_contract_tests.py passed before the final receipt/plan-only edits.
validation.diff_check: git diff --check passed before the final receipt/plan-only edits.
validation.targeted: ctest --test-dir build-gcc -V -R '^dwg2dxf_cli_spatial_index_recovery$' passed 1/1 in 0.50 seconds and reported 15 controls.
validation.aggregate: The dwg2dxf_cli_partial_read_disposition aggregate remains at its latest recorded 917 controls / 29.40 seconds and was not rerun for this isolated profile.

limits: Generated parser recovery and disposition evidence only; producer-authored SPATIAL_INDEX semantics and native spatial-query behavior are not qualified.
The parser treats the body after the timestamps as opaque bounded data; this generated profile has no such suffix and does not qualify arbitrary tails.
AC1024, AC1027, and AC1032 are excluded because no parser-failing one-bit mutation was found in their bounded body spans.
No DWG or DXF fixture file is committed.
